item.title: Katsuura Tuna: Japan's Great Fresh-Tuna Port — Guide
item.description: Nachikatsuura is Japan’s leading port for fresh, never-frozen tuna, landing more of it than anywhere else in the country thanks to a fleet that uses longlines rather than nets, bringing the fish in whole and undamaged. On most mornings the market floor fills with rows of gleaming tuna as buyers inspect and bid, and visitors can watch the whole auction free from a dedicated gallery above — a genuine working market rather than a show.

item.title: Toyama Bay Seafood Market (Shinminato): Fresh Catch Straight From the Port — Guide
item.description: The fishing port of Shinminato, on the eastern edge of Toyama Bay, hosts a lively seafood market where the day’s catch is unloaded, sorted and sold fresh each morning, offering visitors a direct look at the bay’s fishing industry alongside stalls selling seafood to take home or eat on the spot. Surrounding restaurants serve the market’s catch immediately, making it a good stop for a casual seafood meal that traces directly back to the boats docked just outside.
